title: AbsTopK: Rethinking Sparse Autoencoders For Bidirectional Features

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Spurious Correlation Removal (SCR) by creating datasets with spurious correlations (e.g., associating male with professor and female with nurse), training a biased classifier, and measuring the accuracy improvement (debiasing) achieved by ablating selected Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latents.
